prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for 'adoption, new_flow' and 'finish, new_screen', as each category has only 1 test.
For 'adoption, redesign', noise-corrected results consistently show ~+2.6% gain across 2 tests; it proved helpful when significant (Round 6), though Round 4 showed no clear effect.
Predictions were too high for 'finish, new_screen' and 'adoption, new_flow' compared to noise-corrected results.
Predictions for 'adoption, redesign' were accurate compared to noise-corrected results.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +2.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: +2.6% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- finish, new_screen: -0.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 70.2%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 20.5%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, hint] Sign In Account Persistence Banner: Add a clear account persistence notice explaining that signing in ensures pets and custom progress are cloud-saved across app restarts. (why: 8 support emails reported pets missing or reset after signing in again, leading to user confusion and dropoff.)
1: [adoption, wait_info] Custom Pet Generation Status Indicator: Display real-time visual step indicators showing progress (analyzing photo, rendering model) while custom pet is generating. (why: Adoption step has high dropoff (70.2% conversion, 89s median / 1017s mean) and 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures.)
2: [finish, redesign] Desktop Control Overview Walkthrough: Redesign home_intro into a spotlight layout explaining system tray access, pet interaction shortcuts, and pet visibility controls. (why: Finish conversion is low at 64.8% and 3 support emails noted post-onboarding confusion on how to control or hide the pet.)
3: [adoption, new_screen] Pet Naming Certificate Screen: Add a dedicated pet naming and adoption signing screen before final certificate generation with interactive pet naming input. (why: Adoption step takes a long mean time (1017s) with 70.2% dropoff; adding clear milestone ownership increases emotional commitment.)
4: [sign_in, reorder] Delayed Sign In Reordering Flow: Move the sign_in step after pet selection and photo upload, right before adoption certificate confirmation. (why: Sign-in conversion is 72.9% early in the funnel; letting users pick/create their pet first builds motivation before asking for account creation.)
5: [home, redesign] Background Pet Preparation Waiting Screen: Redesign the waiting screen with a split layout featuring interactive tip carousels and estimated completion time while pet assets load. (why: Home step waiting time has a high median of 201s and mean of 2336s, causing significant drop-off before finishing.)
6: [choose_path, layout] Path Selection Benefit Cards: Update choose_path layout to two_column spotlight view clearly contrasting Quick Adopt (preset pet) vs Custom Creator (photo pet) paths. (why: choose_path loses 23.8% of users with an 8s median / 514s mean time, suggesting hesitation between paths.)
7: [choose_path, incentive] Pre-load Mascot Welcome Story: Add an encouraging welcome headline and progress tracker component on the story screen to set clear expectations for the onboarding process. (why: Early dropoff at choose_path / story step accounts for 23.8% of overall user loss before sign-in.)
8: [finish, hint] Desktop Visibility Diagnostic Notice: Add a clear diagnostic hint on home_intro explaining how to restore or bring the pet to front if display issues or multi-monitor overlaps occur. (why: 3 support tickets reported pet not showing on desktop or app not opening after completion.)
9: [adoption, new_flow] Interactive Companion Habit Setup Flow: Add a habit selection sub-flow during adoption where users choose their pet's primary behavior mode on the desktop. (why: Adoption dropoff is high, and early customization of pet behavior increases user investment and reduces post-onboarding confusion.)
